label: No being is jointly omniscient, omnipotent and wholly good, by Natural-deduction (2)
meaning: Conditional deductive core of Rowe’s argument. Instantiate the actual suffering witness at a supposed omniscient omnipotent wholly good being; premise (1) excludes its blocking cost, while the necessary permission condition supplies one. Both philosophical premises remain open; no epistemic warrant or actual gratuitous suffering is proved.
